behavior: AC1: converge --plan lists each applicable reconciler with its action and changes nothing
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestConvergePlan_ListsApplicableReconcilersAndTouchesNothing$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestConvergePlan_ListsApplicableReconcilersAndTouchesNothing'

behavior: AC2: records-harness deploys every applicable agents.presence instruction file before any later reconciler, and its probe fails while one is missing or stale
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^(TestRecordsHarness_ProbeFailsWhenTheDeployLeftAFileOut|TestRecordsHarness_ApplyDeploysAndASecondPlanIgnoresThePresenceRegion)$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRecordsHarness_ProbeFailsWhenTheDeployLeftAFileOut' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRecordsHarness_ApplyDeploysAndASecondPlanIgnoresThePresenceRegion'

behavior: AC3: a second converge on a converged HOME reports zero native changes and persists the report
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestConverge_SecondRunIsANoOpAndPersistsTheReport$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestConverge_SecondRunIsANoOpAndPersistsTheReport'

behavior: AC4: a reconciler whose probe fails makes converge exit non-zero and names it
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^TestRun_FailedProbeFailsTheRunNamingTheReconciler$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRun_FailedProbeFailsTheRunNamingTheReconciler'

behavior: AC5: a reconciler that does not list the current OS is reported skipped with the OS named
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^TestRun_UnlistedPlatformIsSkippedNotPassed$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRun_UnlistedPlatformIsSkippedNotPassed'

behavior: AC6: install.sh installs dotf at the pin with checksum and exec probe, hands off to converge, and places nothing on failure (bash 3.2 and zsh)
AC6: install.ps1 has the same contract on Windows
AC7: no live file references the old installer names or the clone-and-setup flow
AC8: dotf update runs converge and keeps its exit semantics
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/update/ -count=1 && go test ./internal/update/ -run '^TestUpdate_RunsConvergeAfterAFastForward$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestUpdate_RunsConvergeAfterAFastForward'

behavior: AC9: from-zero CI on macos-latest: install, doctor, then a second converge with zero native changes
verification: gh run list --workflow from-zero.yml --branch main --event push --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion' | grep -qx success

behavior: AC2: the records step runs the skill deploy (compile-harness.sh --deploy) on every apply, even when the instruction files are current
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^TestRecordsHarness_ApplyRunsTheDeployEvenWhenInstructionsAreCurrent$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRecordsHarness_ApplyRunsTheDeployEvenWhenInstructionsAreCurrent'

behavior: AC10: a template change merged to main is planned by converge's configs step, fails its probe until applied, and lands on apply
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^TestConfigsDeploy_ATemplateChangeIsPlannedAndFailsTheProbeUntilApplied$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestConfigsDeploy_ATemplateChangeIsPlannedAndFailsTheProbeUntilApplied'

behavior: AC10: a render the secret store could not complete keeps the installed config and the run goes on
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/deploy/ -run '^TestRun_AnIncompleteRenderKeepsTheInstalledFile$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRun_AnIncompleteRenderKeepsTheInstalledFile'

behavior: AC1: a plan of a rendered config creates nothing under HOME
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/deploy/ -run '^TestRun_APlanOfARenderedEntryCreatesNoDirectory$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRun_APlanOfARenderedEntryCreatesNoDirectory'

behavior: AC11: on macOS, converge writes the contract variables into the launchd session and loads the login agent; a second run changes nothing
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/converge/ -run '^TestEnvPersist_ApplyThenSecondRunIsZero$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestEnvPersist_ApplyThenSecondRunIsZero'
